summary: Cloudflare adapter composition root for first-party executable plugins. Modules are registered in code, loaded dynamically, and invoked in-process through the shared PluginExecutionPort; this directory owns no journal, retry loop, staging or publication.

key_files.index.ts: Lazy composition root: resolve an in-code plugin binding and construct the in-process execution port with hosted ExecutorContext services.
key_files.in-process.ts: One module invocation with a timeout and per-isolate submit replay keyed by durable invocationId. Returns the protocol result; never publishes.
key_files.registry.ts: Closed allowlist of Worker-safe first-party executor modules plus their manifest version/schema hash. Dynamic import keeps plugin JSON out of startup.
key_files.context.ts: Invocation-scoped store/upload/asset/document/reference ports. Credentials come from the selected provider account and never enter the journal.

compatibility: Only the in-process binding exists today. The shared port keeps container and remote bindings typed but unbound.
A provider route is admitted only when its executor plugin id is explicitly allowlisted and its module imports no node:fs or child_process at module scope.
